correctness.rationale: All parent-selection probabilities are explicit; recurrences for the leaf count, path length and leaf-depth sum follow from conditional expectation. The derived δ_n recursion has positive initial value and strictly positive forcing for all θ>0; C_{n+1}=C_n−δ_n/W_n gives C_n<0 for n≥3. A closed δ_n expression and finite summation yield the exact covariance. Harmonic bounds give Oθ(log n/n); Leckey–Neininger Theorems 2.5/2.6 supply separate positive leading variances for the correlation constant. Exact-rational full enumeration verified five θ values and n=2..9, 231165 tree instances and 208 assertions. No inference of infinite truth from computation.

originality.rationale: Specific θ≠1 Hoppe root-bias cross-covariance and strict all-θ sign are not entailed by the inspected 2012 Hoppe marginal results, 2017 weighted recursive-tree degree results, or 2026 homogeneous recursive-tree multivariate generator. The θ=1 special case is acknowledged as implicitly covered and is not used to claim novelty. Targeted published-record searches and comparisons with prior scientific results found no stronger θ≠1 claim. Potential inaccessible early path-length results remain a priority uncertainty, not a demonstrated dominating theorem.
residual_risks: The 2026 multivariate generating-function identity implicitly determines θ=1 moments and must remain credited; θ=1 is not a standalone original result.
The complete Dobrow–Fill 1999 paper was not materially available; it might contain a relevant alternative mixed-moment calculation for uniform recursion.
Unindexed or earlier arbitrary-root-weight joint statistics could supersede the novelty assessment; semantic retrieval cannot establish absolute uniqueness.

value.rationale: Leaf count measures peripheral branching while total root-to-vertex depth measures global search cost. Their dependence is mathematically natural but marginal Hoppe-tree CLTs and path-length limits do not determine mixed covariance, sign, or the universal −n/4 slope. The all-positive-root-weight strict anticorrelation and exact root-weight-dependent n^{-1/2} correlation coefficient reveal an interpretable finite-size and asymptotic structural relation rather than a chosen arbitrary parameter slice. The θ=1 special case is appropriately treated as prior implicit coverage.
